review.why: Investigates a session that went wrong by reading transcripts, citing evidence for every finding, and optionally preparing a scrubbed bug-report bundle.
review.summary: Steps: pin down the problem, locate session files, run seven analyst subagents in parallel, write a report where every finding cites a file and line, then optionally search and create a GitHub issue after approval, export a scrubbed bundle on request, and compare similar sessions. Hard rules: read-only on sessions, context safety, and exact paths for subagents.
strengths: No citation, no finding: every number comes from the transcript
Never builds a bundle or opens an issue without being asked and approved
Scrub then audit loop with a warning that redaction can miss things
cautions: Meant for users of one skill collection and its harnesses
Nineteen prompt, reference and template files are not read here
